_comment: Per-POCKET-DIMENSION shaders and textures, applied by PocketQuests (PocketSkins).
THE TWO HALVES COST VERY DIFFERENT AMOUNTS, so they are scheduled differently.
Textures are not. reloadResourcePacks() re-stitches every atlas, re-parses GeckoLib,
regenerates Every Compat textures and rebuilds the whole JEI index, on the render thread.
Running that DURING a dimension change, on top of terrain loading, is what produced the old
thirty-minute hang. It is now DEFERRED: queued on the dimension change, then fired only once
the terrain screen is gone, no loading overlay is up, the player is alive, their chunk is
loaded, and all of that has held for switchDelayTicks consecutive ticks.
Deferring does not make the reload FASTER. It makes it a defined pause after you have landed
instead of an open-ended hang mid-teleport. The real duration is now timed and reported in
chat and the log, because the figure written in this file before was badly wrong.
COST SCALES WITH TRANSITIONS, NOT WITH THE NUMBER OF PACKS. A reload happens only when the
desired pack set DIFFERS from what is already selected, so two pocket dimensions sharing a
pack switch between each other for free. An empty list means vanilla, which is a perfectly
ONE SHADER PER TEXTURE PACK. Shaders are cheap (Iris just recompiles the pack, seconds) and
apply IMMEDIATELY on the dimension change, so they are the instant feedback stepping through
an arch. Pairing them 1:1 with the texture packs means a transit changes BOTH or NEITHER, so
no transit becomes slow that was not already - the five free ones stay free.
Faithful 64x        -> Complementary Reimagined   vanilla-like, matches crisp vanilla art
Excalibur           -> BSL (perf tag: low)        warm and contrasty, medieval stone/fire
JICKLUS             -> Nostalgia (medium)         warm vanilla-like fantasy, same palette
horror-desaturated  -> Spooklementary             purpose-built horror, Complementary-based
Redstone land is the one exception: same Faithful textures, but MakeUp Ultra Fast (modrinth
perf tag 'potato', the cheapest available) because FPS while building large contraptions
matters more there than atmosphere. Set shadersEnabled false if even that is unwelcome.
Nothing here is heavier than what was already running everywhere (Complementary Reimagined),
so this costs no performance relative to before - two of the five are explicitly lighter.
FOUR packs cover everything; no pocket dimension is left on bare vanilla. The hub carries
Faithful 64x because it is the most widely shared one, which makes the most transits free.
All four were chosen on MEASURED coverage against all 1617 vanilla 1.21.1 block and item
textures, not on pack_format or on a sample: Faithful 64x 100%, Excalibur 97%, JICKLUS 96%.
Majestica was dropped at 69% - a third of its blocks fall back to vanilla 16x right beside
its 32x work, which defeats the point. Re-measure with tools/get_texture_packs.py.
64x is the agreed ceiling: higher multiplies atlas cost and so lengthens the switch pause,
while the 247 mods stay 16x regardless.
A real dimension with no entry of its own INHERITS its pocket dimension's packs and shader
(PocketSkins.skinFor), so hub:skyblock_nether follows hub:skyblock automatically. Give one
an explicit entry only when it should deliberately differ from its own overworld.
switchDelayTicks: 60 = three seconds of calm after landing. Raise it if the pause still lands
while chunks are streaming in; lower it if three seconds feels like dead air.
